Theorem
[Excision for relative homology] ↗ lem:boundary-composition-zero 1. ch2:2.20\group Singular Homology

If $Z\subset A\subset X$ and $\overline Z\subset \operatorname {int}A$, then inclusion induces isomorphisms \[ H_n(X-Z,A-Z)\cong H_n(X,A). \] Equivalently, if $\operatorname {int}A\cup \operatorname {int}B=X$, then $H_n(B,A\cap B)\cong H_n(X,A)$.

For an open cover $\mathcal U=\{ U_j\} $, let $C_n^{\mathcal U}(X)$ be generated by singular simplices whose images lie in one $U_j$, and let $H_n^{\mathcal U}(X)$ be its homology.
